item.title: MCP Security 101
item.description:
Author: Alessandro Pignati
Date: December 24, 2025
Tags: ["AI Security", "Enterprise Technology", "Model Context Protocol", "Cybersecurity", "Autonomous AI Agents"]
Summary:
  • AI agents now perform complex, multi-step workflows beyond text generation.
  • The Model Context Protocol (MCP) enables AI agents to access external tools and services.
  • MCP introduces a new security perimeter with high-privilege permissions.
  • The 'God-Mode' problem arises from unvetted access granted to AI tools.
  • Securing AI agent actions is critical for enterprise risk and compliance.
  • Traditional security models must evolve to address MCP-related threats.
